title: Premium non-3D website design: an editorial system that stays cinematic, accessible, and fast
research_question: How can a premium, editorial, cinematic website feel distinctive through typography, art direction, composition, and restrained motion without depending on 3D or sacrificing accessibility, mobile behavior, or loading performance?
